readers.framing: a maintainer of the library who has to implement this requirement and wants to know exactly what code to write

readings.summary: Make the unguarded DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] accesses in TypeCollector null-safe (FirstOrDefault, fall back to no/None location) so GetObjectInfo can run on metadata closed-generic structs without throwing, and the generator still collects and emits the type normally.
readings.code_difference: Only replaces the indexing at the crash sites with FirstOrDefault and tolerates a null location when reporting diagnostics; the closed-generic-from-metadata path in CollectGeneric still calls GetObjectInfo and the type is processed as usual.

readings.summary: Avoid calling GetObjectInfo on closed generics whose definition has no syntax by changing CollectGeneric to skip or handle metadata symbols differently, rather than just guarding the location lookups.
readings.code_difference: Adds a branch in CollectGeneric/CollectCore that detects metadata-only generic value types (no declaring syntax) and takes a different path (skip, or use a formatter-based/no-diagnostic route), changing what is collected for such types.

readers.framing: the person who filed this issue, later checking whether what shipped is what they asked for

readings.summary: Make the generator and analyzer robust to metadata symbols by guarding the unguarded DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] accesses so that no exception is thrown, with the closed generic struct from a referenced assembly being processed and a resolver generated.
readings.code_difference: Replaces direct DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] indexing with null-safe FirstOrDefault-style location lookups (falling back to no location) in the diagnostic paths, while still running GetObjectInfo on the closed generic metadata type and generating a formatter for it.

readers.framing: a QA engineer who has to write acceptance tests for this requirement before any code exists

readings.summary: Make the generator and analyzer robust by guarding every DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] access (use FirstOrDefault/null-safe locations) so metadata symbols no longer crash, while still generating the closed generic struct's formatter and resolver as for other types.
readings.code_difference: Replaces the unguarded indexing at the diagnostic sites with null-safe location lookup, and the closed generic metadata struct still goes through GetObjectInfo and gets processed/serialized normally.

readings.summary: Avoid analyzing the referenced-assembly generic struct's members via GetObjectInfo in the closed-generic branch (e.g. skip or treat it differently when it has no syntax), so no source-location code is reached for it.
readings.code_difference: Adds a check in CollectGeneric to bypass or special-case metadata-only types rather than just making location lookups null-safe, which could change whether a formatter is generated for Item<int>.
